instructions: Read the category, then its complete module task pack before authoring. Property-name signatures are navigation aids, not complete constraints.
Each task pack includes all nodes in its selected module family and explicit dependencies; this pilot does not select arbitrary individual definitions.
Use the same source revision for schema and runtime. The frozen source is required until a verified public source identity is added; the published214 CDN does not contain this schema-source tooling.
For cross-module documents, use the selection CLI or the generated full schema. Never concatenate $defs manually.
Run same-version validateDocument and task-specific interaction checks; structural schema success alone is insufficient.
